title: Forces & Pressure
summary: Pushes, pulls, invisible forces, friction, gravity and pressure. Why knives are sharp, why dams are thick at the bottom, and how warm seas grow cyclones.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Understanding how forces interact and how pressure depends on force and area helps us design safer, more effective solutions to everyday problems.

factual: What is a force, and what can it do?
What is the difference between mass and weight?
conceptual: How do balanced and unbalanced forces change motion?
Why does pressure in a liquid increase with depth?
How do differences in air pressure create winds and cyclones?
debatable: Is friction more of a friend or an enemy?
How far should governments go to force people to evacuate before a cyclone?
